topic: Countries with the most islands (national counts)

sources.title: List of countries by number of islands
Which country has the most islands?

claims.text: Statistics Sweden counted 267,570 islands (2013 inventory); Sweden tops the list.
claims.quote: Statistics Sweden counted 267,570 islands in its 2013 inventory; The winner — by quite some margin — is Sweden
claims.label: national count

claims.text: A 2025 comparison of national totals ranks Sweden 267,570, Norway 239,057, Finland 178,947.
claims.quote: ranks Sweden first with 267,570, Norway second with 239,057 and Finland third with 178,947
claims.label: national counts, methods differ

claims.text: Sweden's count included areas as small as nine square metres.
claims.quote: The smallest included areas measured just nine square metres

myths.myth: Indonesia (or the Philippines) has the most islands.
myths.truth: By national counts, Sweden, Norway and Finland each count far more; their rules count tiny islets.

open_questions: Norway's count varies by source (about 55,000 to 239,057).
